macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks finish mixed after sharp intraday reversal
items.summary: The Dow rose 0.33% to 50,182.95 after recovering from an early decline of more than 1,100 points. The S&P 500 fell 0.25% to 7,182.78 and the Nasdaq Composite dropped 0.62% to 23,585.80 as technology and semiconductor shares remained under pressure.[2][3]

items.title: U.S. inflation strengthens expectations for December Fed hike
items.summary: October personal-consumption expenditures inflation rose 0.3% month over month and 3.8% year over year, while core PCE inflation accelerated to 3.3% annually. The data, combined with resilient economic activity, reinforced expectations of a 25-basis-point Federal Reserve rate increase in December.[3][5]

items.title: U.S. third-quarter GDP revised sharply higher
items.summary: Second-estimate data showed annualized U.S. GDP growth of 4.3% in the third quarter, up from the previous 3.4% estimate and above the 3.5% consensus forecast. The stronger growth complicates the Fed’s policy decision because inflation remains elevated.[3]

items.title: Fed Beige Book reports modest expansion across most districts
items.summary: Eight of the Federal Reserve’s 12 districts reported slight-to-moderate economic growth, while four reported little or no change. The report indicated continued expansion but did not signal broad-based acceleration.[2]

items.title: New U.S. tariff proposals add market uncertainty
items.summary: The U.S. proposed new Section 301 tariffs affecting 14 trading partners, raising concerns about supply chains, inflation and global trade. Tariff risks contributed to pressure on technology and internationally exposed shares.[3][5]

items.title: Technology and semiconductor shares lead declines
items.summary: Nvidia fell about 3.9%, while semiconductor stocks broadly weakened as investors questioned the durability of the artificial-intelligence rally. HP was a notable exception, rising about 11% after reporting strong results.[4]

items.title: HP rallies after earnings and outlook
items.summary: HP shares advanced sharply in after-hours trading after the company reported strong earnings and issued an optimistic fiscal 2027 outlook. Autodesk and Workday fell after cautious guidance, while Nutanix extended its decline.[1]

items.title: German stocks fall after GDP downgrade
items.summary: Germany’s DAX declined 1.26% to 24,702.13 after revised data showed third-quarter GDP growth of only 0.1%, adding to concerns about the strength of Europe’s largest economy.[5]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds after dropping below $58,000
items.summary: Bitcoin briefly fell to about $57,300 before recovering to roughly $60,000–$60,500. November spot Bitcoin ETF outflows reportedly approached $4.7 billion, while Ethereum traded around $1,690, up modestly over 24 hours.

items.title: Ukraine advances crypto taxation and market rules
items.summary: Ukraine’s parliament passed legislation covering crypto taxation, market supervision and investor protection. The measure reportedly sets a combined 23% tax on crypto profits from July 2027, subject to presidential approval.

items.title: SEC staff declines enforcement recommendation for token sale
items.summary: SEC staff said it would not recommend enforcement action against Molecule’s U.S. unit for selling biotech research tokens without registration, according to a letter dated November 24.

items.title: SBI, SMFG and Solana launch joint venture
items.summary: SBI Holdings, Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group and the Solana Foundation began operations under SBI Solana Global, focusing on stablecoin payments, settlement infrastructure and asset tokenization.

items.title: Fidelity adds Aave, Chainlink and Uniswap to retail platform
items.summary: Fidelity Investments added AAVE, LINK and UNI to its Fidelity Crypto retail trading platform, expanding the tokens available to its customers.

items.title: Osmosis restricts transfers after security incident
items.summary: The Cosmos-based decentralized exchange Osmosis restricted transfers involving approximately 84,000 wallets and froze 64 suspected attacker accounts following an incident linked to Web3Auth.

items.title: Ethereum researchers recommend Keccak-256 for post-quantum transition
items.summary: Ethereum Foundation researchers recommended Keccak-256 as the network’s hash function for a planned move toward hash-based cryptography.

items.title: Bithumb pledges compensation after data leak
items.summary: South Korean exchange Bithumb said it would compensate affected users after the scope of a data leak widened, adding a major security incident to the day’s crypto news.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: OpenAI demonstrates GPT-6 protein-design capabilities
items.summary: OpenAI reported that GPT-6 models can design novel protein structures and sequences through reasoning and code, with reported wet-lab validation of some designs. The development highlights a growing use of frontier models as scientific research tools.

items.title: Anthropic expands Claude’s agent and desktop capabilities
items.summary: Anthropic expanded Claude’s agent features, including tools for turning Claude Artifacts into installable Windows and macOS applications. The company also introduced Claude Ship for automating parts of GitHub pull-request review and approval.

items.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon
items.summary: Google introduced Gemini 4 Neon, positioning it as a faster, lower-cost frontier model with strong reasoning performance for developers. The release reflects continued competition among major laboratories to improve price-performance and inference speed.

items.title: PrismML releases compact Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B model
items.summary: PrismML released an aggressively compressed 27-billion-parameter model that reduces storage requirements to roughly 5.9 GB by using three-value weights. The model is aimed at local and on-device coding and tool-use applications.

items.title: Cognition releases SWE-2.1 coding model
items.summary: Cognition announced SWE-2.1, reporting a substantial improvement over its prior model on the Terminal-Bench 4.1 evaluation and a faster version optimized for Cerebras hardware. The release adds to the rapid competition in autonomous software-engineering agents.

items.title: Epochal launches historical web environment for AI agents
items.summary: Epochal introduced Time Portal, a historical web environment that gives forecasting agents access to web pages and computing tools restricted to a chosen date. The system is designed to support more realistic evaluation and training of agents for prediction tasks.

items.title: Ant Group releases open medical AI models
items.summary: Ant Group released LingSante-3.1-flash and LingSante-3.1-air-VL medical models on Hugging Face under the MIT license. The move expands the availability of openly licensed models targeted at medical-language and vision-language applications.

items.title: NVIDIA releases Alpamayo 2 Edge for autonomous driving
items.summary: NVIDIA released Alpamayo 2 Edge, a compact model designed for in-car autonomous-driving applications. The launch reflects the industry shift toward deploying capable models directly on edge hardware rather than relying exclusively on cloud inference.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Capcom to shut down Exoprimal servers in 2027
items.summary: Capcom announced that its online dinosaur shooter Exoprimal will end service on September 29, 2027, across all regions.[1]

items.title: Counter-Strike 2 confirmed for Esports World Cup through 2028
items.summary: Counter-Strike 2 will return for the 2027 and 2028 Esports World Cup, extending its participation to five consecutive editions. League of Legends, Valorant, Dota 2, Chess and Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves were also confirmed for 2027.[2]

items.title: EA Sports FC 27 adds AI-recreated John Motson commentary
items.summary: EA Sports FC 27 is set to add an optional AI-generated voice modeled on late football commentator John Motson, marking the FIFA series’ first use of a deceased real-world announcer.[3]

items.title: Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens gets December release date
items.summary: Everflux Games announced that the mystical action-adventure game Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens will launch on December 8.[4]

items.title: Neowiz partners with Winterkeep Interactive
items.summary: South Korean publisher Neowiz announced a publishing partnership with Swedish development studio Winterkeep Interactive.[4]

items.title: Thunderbirds Roblox experience announced
items.summary: ITV Studios unveiled a Roblox experience based on the original 1960s Thunderbirds television series, recreating its vehicles, launch sequences and visual style for a modern audience.[5]
